verdict.rationale: Lever's own Automation Hub is described as handling routine tasks such as archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates. Advanced Nurture also automates outreach and follow-ups, so background automation is a first-party capability. The evidence is only marketing-level, with no detail on how users configure automations, what triggers or schedules exist, or how autonomous runs are monitored. missing for 10: documented automation setup and trigger/rule configuration, recurring schedule details, run monitoring/logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
